name: Love Slave, Flaming Passion
overview:
Five years ago, Kuanda was cruelly hurt by her first love, Wittaya. Left stranded on the streets, she met Payup, who fell for her at first sight. Through a twist of fate, the two entered into a lovers' agreement. One day, after a passionate night with Payup, Kuanda was told their relationship would end early. At the same time, her medical report revealed she had only three months left to live. Despite her reluctance, she decided to give up her beloved and leave.

The next day, Kuanda saw Payup and Fahsai walking arm in arm at the company. Feeling abandoned, she resigned. Soon after leaving the company, the local bully Surachat found Kuanda, deliberately provoked her, and threatened Janjira to force Kuanda to accompany him to a party. At the party, Kuanda met Payup again – and a painful love story began to unfold.
